name: WHO emergencies
summary: WHO's Ebola emergency of international concern, declared on 17 May, remains in force; no new PHEIC found
state: The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak centred on DR Congo was determined a public health emergency of international concern on 17 May (WHO). Africa CDC said on 15 Nov the outbreak is still not under control (Al Jazeera), and ECDC's 19 Nov update shows community transmission continuing (ECDC). Searches to 20 Nov found no new PHEIC in the past 30 days and no pandemic emergency, so a PHEIC in effect keeps Watch.
for_you: Travellers to DR Congo and neighbouring countries should follow FCDO travel advice and WHO guidance. The UK risk remains low according to UKHSA.
rubric_hit: A PHEIC in effect (Ebola, since 17 May) = Watch; no new PHEIC in past 30 days

rubric.alert: A new PHEIC declared in the past 30 days, or a pandemic emergency declared.
rubric.watch: A PHEIC in effect, or an IHR Emergency Committee convened.
rubric.normal: No PHEIC in effect other than long-running polio.
